methodology: Actual Player.spawn and awaited move through generated terrain, visibility, encounter accumulator, actual EncounterBuilder and complete CombatManager fights with Game ability dispatch, real termination, loot and XP. Public settlement quest publication with loaded DungeonManager/Generator, NPC, Merchant, Loot and Relation consumers. Destination-bound overland return, no dungeon entry or quest commissions. A* grants full traversable-terrain navigation foresight; not a measured natural-player route distribution. Locally visible ambiguous POIs within three tiles may be inspected with at most eight additional moves each, independent of hidden resolved type/provisioning. Provisioning only after actual shelter revelation and only with capacity. All optional road skill events declined. Camp at >=75 with more than one supply, last supply reserved until >=90. Actual short rests below55%HP, actual stock purchase then long rest at returned safe town. Upper-level selected choices pass the actual UI validator before real confirmation; fixed diagnostic snapshots, not earned playthrough progression, and pending earned progression deferred. Fixed RNG and Date.now are harness-only. Actual repaired live RestManager recovers resources using loaded ability definitions; no synthetic recharge or Character rest substitute. Practice selections legal but active practice effects unexercised. No companions. Outcomes cluster by fifteen worlds and sequential combats; CIs are descriptive, not independent population estimates.
